entities.summary: Volodymyr Semenovych Boyko was a Ukrainian metallurgist, entrepreneur, and politician who is a recipient of the Hero of Ukraine and Order of Merit. Additionally, he was a member of the Ukrainian Verkhovna Rada from 2002 to 2007 and 2012 to 2014.
